text:
Hands that hate calm are not for the Lyre;

to sing to you I have plucked my soul!

With the tremor of a bride at her beginning,

with the bewilderment of a novice,

the innocence of the pages, a flock of gazelles,

awaits before my eyes the coming of the Canticle,

virgin as the foam of the Atlantic

before the passing of the caravels...

translation.title: They Are Not for the Lyre...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the invocation to song and the untouched Atlantic image before the caravels.
